ITEM 1 | Pile of brown-to-tan meat pieces with darker seared edges, irregular bite-sized strips about 1.5-3 cm, slightly glossy and moist, holding a loose mound shape on the plate | 95
ITEM 2 | Dark green leafy herb pieces, flat leaves about 2-4 cm, scattered through and around the meat, slightly wilted and glistening with oil | 12
ITEM 3 | Small thin red chili slices and bits, bright red, about 0.5-1 cm long, scattered among the meat | 2
ITEM 4 | Small pale tan granular bits (possibly crumbled or chopped aromatics), about 0.3-0.5 cm, mixed in the meat pile, drier and matte | 5
ITEM 5 | Thin glossy film of brown cooking liquid coating the meat and leaves, pooled lightly on the plate surface around the base of the pile | 4
